_comment: Canonical dinas codes RDT can route a transaction TO (dinas_target). Corrected 29 Jul 2026 (project owner): the previous list was a SYNTHETIC PLACEHOLDER — literally 'T' + every letter A-U sequentially, guessed before the real org structure was available, not GMF's actual GH-level roster. Replaced with the real 21-GH structure from struktur-dinas-gmf.png (project owner supplied): TG/TK/TO/TT never existed as real dinas (dropped); TV/TX/TZ/DFR are real GH units that were simply missing (added) — DFR (Management Risk GH) intentionally doesn't follow the 'T+letter' shape, this list has no length/prefix assumption so that's fine. 'Corp' stays as the separate no-dedicated-PIC catch-all bucket (REQ-RDT-AUTH-04) — unrelated to the org chart, unchanged. Deliberately does NOT include 'TAB' — that's the admin division running RDT itself, not an operational dinas that can receive a repost transaction (backend/sql/schema.sql's comment on rdt.dinas is explicit that TAB has no row there on purpose, so a dinas_target of 'TAB' fails the transactions_dinas_target_fkey constraint outright). 'TAB people confirm it' just means role TAB (which can act on ANY dinas via requireDinasAccess) — it does NOT mean the target value itself becomes 'TAB'. Used by excelParser.js so an exact code resolves even with no mapping.seed.json entry, and to detect GMF's sub-dinas naming convention — a real code plus extra trailing letters with no separator (e.g. dinas TM's own sub-unit written as 'TMM') — confirmed as a GMF-wide convention by the project owner, 28 Jul 2026.
